Completing GST Return

Did you zero-rate your supplies just because your customer is overseas?

Goods: You cannot apply zero-rating if you are unable to confirm that the goods will be exported at the time of supply, or if you do not have sufficient export documentation.

Services: Zero-rating is not allowed if the service does not meet the criteria for an international service under the relevant rules.

Box 2: Total value of zero-rated supplies

Supplies of international services as listed in section 21(3) of GST Act.

Supplies of goods which are exported (must maintain required documents to support your zero-rating).

Providing international services (not all services provided to overseas customers are zero-rated supplies).
